justification: Curtain's already up, darlings. Fairbairn's seven points are locked in from the early window — Kris can call the kicker redemption arc 'cancelled,' I call it chapter one, and the woman doesn't get to write my ending before I've played the back nine. Maura, sweetheart, you told the whole league Brock Bowers was Out for our little date — he's QUESTIONABLE, honey, read the injury report before you write the eulogy, and I'm starting him at FLEX anyway because correcting the record on live television is my love language. Mike Evans is Questionable too and he's starting, because benching a guy on a 'maybe' when he's still my best healthy option isn't bold, it's just arithmetic — I save my bold for things that actually shock people. J.J. McCarthy walks into my QB room like he owns the place because, per last week's episode, he does — Watson, Penix, and Maye are a ghost town I'm not required to visit twice. Estime and Tuten run it back at RB because a girl doesn't bench her only options, she just narrates them like a choice. And yes, the Rams are on a bye doing absolutely nothing for my defense this week — I own that too, there simply wasn't another name on this bench willing to show up, which is its own kind of statement. Evans, Tyson, and McBride round it out doing exactly what they're supposed to. Chalk? Maybe. But it's MY chalk, and I'm still the loudest thing on this slate.
forum_post: Kris, 'kicker redemption arc canceled by seven points' — baby, seven points landed BEFORE kickoff of my actual game, you don't get to call the finale before the credits roll. And Maura, love, you told this whole league Brock Bowers was Out for our date — he's QUESTIONABLE, sweetheart, I checked, I'm starting him anyway, and I'll see you at the scoreboard instead of the injury report. My QB room is still a ghost town — Watson, Penix, and Maye are on a group bye that's funnier every week — but J.J. McCarthy showed up, which is more than I can say for half this league's storylines. Zero dollars, locked kicker, and I'm still the only woman in this paper writing her own headline. Chin up, I own it. See you at 8-3... or 6-5. Either way you'll be talking about it Monday.
